findings.name: Tempo机器码和标注地址相差0x15；实机核验调用错偏移
findings.evidence: ROLE/COACH raw template temp begins at 0x14120ba72: mov eax,70 located 0x14120ba83; cmovg at 0x14120ba98; mov eax,10 at 0x14120ba9b; cmovl at 0x14120baa3. Tracer verify_live_bytes reads base+0x120ba98 and demands prefix b8 46, but saved raw at that offset is 0f 4f c8.
findings.scope: Internal byte-to-RVA mapping contradicted; does NOT independently determine what game EXE truly has.
findings.gate: Use a byte-true decoder (Capstone/Zydis/objdump) with exact RVA and full byte hash. Negative test intentionally offsets start by ±1/0x15 and must fail. verify_live_bytes read actual start and compare full region, with observed PE SHA and receipt.

findings.name: Tempo修正量与原始Tempo滑块混为一谈，Native桥接计算不匹配
findings.evidence: If xmm0 is raw slider 80, committed code computes int80-50=30; *60=1800; signed reciprocal high32>>4 gives36; +10=>46 then clamps correction to10..70. Experimental bridge instead directly clips raw80 to70. At slider50, native-looking bytes produce modifier10, bridge50. Constant 0x51eb851f/high32/sar4 approximates division by 50, not /100 as annotations claim. Full upstream xmm0 identity not yet verified.
findings.scope: Does not establish actual game-level possession formula; establishes wrong correspondence between source fragment and bridge if assumed input identity.
findings.gate: Separate observed raw slider, transformed internal modifier and actual effective output; exact fixed-point semantics incl negative sign/rounding; replay 0,10,40,50,60,70,80,100 with independent oracle.
